enlighten.term.hit_damage:
Any non-[Ailments](ailment) damage is a Hit.

[Damaging Ailments](damaging_ailment) which result from a Hit will calculate their damage from that Hit, and will not subsequently have Damage modifiers applied directly to them. As a result of this, raising Hit Damage will result in more powerful Damaging Ailments innately.
enlighten.term.buff:
Buffs are effects that boost a player or monster's stats for a duration or while a condition is met.

Unless otherwise stated, Buffs of the same type do not stack — only the copy with the strongest effect applies.
enlighten.term.area: This Skill has an effect that applies to every target in its area, rather than picking specific targets.
enlighten.term.cast_speed_to_cooldown: When cast, Hastebound will count your [Skill Speed](cast_time) as [Cooldown](cooldown).
enlighten.term.chaining:
Effects that Chain are redirected to another target after hitting an enemy.

Projectiles have a base chaining distance of 5 metres. Enemies can be Hit more than once in the same Chain.
enlighten.term.curse:
Curses significantly weaken affected targets.

Different Curses can exist on the same target at the same time.
enlighten.term.damage: Skills that do damage to the target(s).
enlighten.term.heal: Heals are Skills that replenish health of the target(s).
enlighten.term.magic: Magic Skills use raw magic to achieve some effects.
enlighten.term.melee: Melee Skills are those that directly hit with a melee action, dealing Melee damage.
enlighten.term.movement: Movement Skills generally move you in some way upon cast.
enlighten.term.not_affected_by_cast_spee: When cast, [Skill Speed](cast_time) will not affect Stasis.
enlighten.term.projectile:
A Projectile is a moving object or [Skill](spell) that usually impacts with targets when it hits them.

When a group of multiple Projectiles is fired from the same source at the same time, a single target can be hit by all Projectiles unless otherwise specified.
enlighten.term.spell:
In CTE2, all learnable objects in Class screen will be considered as Skill.

The stat of Skill is determined by caster's stat and the inherent stat, Skill level only affects the available slots of [Support gem](support_gem).
enlighten.term.self_damage:
Self-damage skills do damage to its caster.

Self-damage is [Hit](hit_damage), but it won't trigger any stats that allow you cast Skill when [Hit](hit_damage) unless otherwise specified.
enlighten.term.shatter: Shatter skills trigger the [Freeze](freeze) build up, and deal [Accumulated](accumulate) damage as bonus §b☀ Cold§f Damage.
enlighten.term.summon: Summons are Skills that spawn temporary [Allies](allies) which will accompany and fight alongside you.
enlighten.term.thorns: Thorns Skills apply [Thorn](thorn) to an enemy.
enlighten.term.thorn: Thorn is an effect which is consumed when hit by basic attack to deal damage.
enlighten.term.trap:
Traps are constructs which trigger upon contact with an enemy.

There is not limitation to the number of Traps you can have out at a time.
enlighten.term.weapon_skill: Attack Skill directly use your equipped weapon to damage enemies.
enlighten.term.burst: Burst Skills can trigger Elemental Burst when you have the Mage Armor effect.
enlighten.term.aura:
Auras strengthen [Allies](allies) within a radius, or weaken enemies within a radius of the source of the Aura.

§cYou can only have one Aura active at a time.§f
enlighten.term.linker: Linkers require a Combo Starter to be cast, and generate a Combo Linker.
enlighten.term.extender: Extenders require a Combo Linker to be cast, and generate a Combo Extender.
enlighten.term.finisher: Finishers are powerful Skills that require a Combo Extender to be cast. It won't generate anything on cast.
enlighten.term.random_spread: Applicable to [Projectiles](projectile) - causes the projectile to fire at a random angle.
enlighten.term.allies: Your allies include other players that are on the same team as you, [Minions](minions), and any other entity that fights alongside you.
enlighten.term.minions: Minions are summoned [Allies](allies) which accompany and fight alongside you.
enlighten.term.two_handed:
Two-handed weapons take up both main and off-hand slots when equipped.

Anything in your off-hand can't be used when you are two-handed.
enlighten.term.one_handed: One-handed weapons can be placed in the main hand or off hand slot. All one-handed weapon types can be dual-wielded in both main and off-hand slots.
enlighten.term.support_gem:
Support Gems can be inserted into sockets on a Skill Gem in order to modify the effects of that Skill. They only apply to the Skill Gem they are socketed into.

You cannot use multiple Support Gems of the same kind in one Skill.

The number of available Support Gem slot depends on the Skill's level.
enlighten.term.ailment: Ailments are a family of common effects associated with specific [Damage Types](damage_types). The list of Ailments is: [Bleed](bleed), [Burn](burn), [Freeze](freeze), [Electrify](electrify), and [Poison](poison).
enlighten.term.physical_damage:
Physical damage is one of the five [Damage Types](damage_types). It is the most common and the only one reduced by Armor, rather than by a [Resistance](resistances).

Physical damage over time can be inflicted with [Bleed](bleed).
enlighten.term.bleed: Bleed is an [Ailment](ailment) that deals Physical damage over time, and lasts 5 seconds by default.
enlighten.term.fire_damage:
Fire damage is one of the five [Damage Types](damage_types). It is reduced by Fire [Resistance](resistances).

The corresponding [Ailment](ailment) is [Burn](burn).
enlighten.term.burn: Burn is an [Ailment](ailment) that deals Fire damage over time, and lasts for 3 seconds by default.
enlighten.term.cold_damage: Cold damage is one of the five [Damage Types](damage_types). It is reduced by Cold [Resistance](resistances). Cold hits have a chance to build up [Freeze](freeze),
enlighten.term.freeze:
Freeze is an [Ailment](ailment) that slow targets and [accumulate](accumulate) damage.

The accumulated damage will be procced when target get hit by [Shatter](shatter).
enlighten.term.accumulate: Some [Skills](spell) or [Ailments](ailment) will accumulate damage on hit. The accumulated damage can be procced when it meets specific conditions.
enlighten.term.lightning_damage: Lightning damage is one of the five [Damage Types](damage_types). It is reduced by Lightning [Resistance](resistances). Lightning hits have a chance to [Electrify](electrify) enemy.
enlighten.term.electrify:
Electrify is an [Ailment](ailment) that can [accumulate](accumulate) all damage.

The accumulated damage will be procced when target gets [Shocked](shock).
enlighten.term.shock: Shock is a effect that can proc [Accumulated](accumulate) damage generated by [Electrify](electrify).
enlighten.term.chaos_damage:
Chaos damage is one of the five [Damage Types](damage_types). It is reduced by Chaos [Resistance](resistances). Chaos hits have a chance to [Poison](poison) enemy.

Chaos damage is the least common damage type.
enlighten.term.poison: Poison is an [Ailment](ailment) that deals Chaos damage over time, and lasts for 10 seconds by default.
enlighten.term.resistances:
Resistances reduce damage taken of the corresponding damage type — [Fire](fire_damage), [Cold](cold_damage), [Lightning](lightning_damage) or [Chaos](chaos_damage) — up to a Maximum. Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances are Elemental Resistances.

Player resistances are lowered as you level up, and can be improved with Equipment, Passives, and Quest items.

There are also resistances for [Ailment](ailment), these resistances can reduce the chance of you inflict corresponding Ailment.
enlighten.term.armour: Armour reduces Damage taken from Hits. By default, Armour only applies to [Physical Damage](physical_damage).
enlighten.term.evasion: Evasion Rating grants a chance to Evade enemy Hits, preventing them from Hitting you at all. The exact chance to Evade also depends on the attacker's Accuracy.
enlighten.term.attributes:
Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence are the 3 primary attributes. The most important use of Attributes is to meet requirements to use Equipment.

Each Attribute provides a different inherent bonus.
enlighten.term.low_health:
A player or monster is on Low health if it has 30% of its Maximum Health/[Magic Shield](magic_shield) or less.

Only check the higher one if both exist.
enlighten.term.low_mana: You are on Low Mana if you have 30% of your Maximum Mana or less.
enlighten.term.defences:
[Armour](armour), [Evasion Rating](evasion) and [Magic Shield](magic_shield) are the standard Defences. 

Other protective stats such as [Resistances](resistances) are not counted as Defences.
enlighten.term.magic_shield:
Magic Shield is a new damage-absorbed resource that protects your Health by taking damage instead. 

It doesn't share stat with Health.
enlighten.term.low_hp_healing: Boosts healing applied to [Low Health](low_health)/[Magic Shield](magic_shield) targets. It will only apply to the higher one.
enlighten.term.critical_hit:
Critical Hit Chance is rolled once per [Hit](hit_damage), before every other step of the damage calculation. The base chance is 1% and it is hard-capped at 100%.

A successful roll multiplies the Hit by your [Critical Hit Damage](critical_damage).

[Damage over Time](damage_over_time) can never be a Critical Hit.
enlighten.term.critical_damage:
Critical Hit Damage is the multiplier a [Critical Hit](critical_hit) applies. The base value of 100 means a Critical Hit deals §a2x§f damage; the hard cap of 500 means §a6x§f.

It is its own multiplier and is applied after all Increased damage — see [More](more_multiplier).
enlighten.term.accuracy:
Accuracy is §onot§f a chance to hit. It is subtracted from the target's [Dodge Rating](dodge_rating) or [Spell Dodge](spell_dodge) before their chance to avoid your Hit is worked out.

Accuracy has no cap.
enlighten.term.dodge_rating:
Dodge Rating gives a chance to avoid a [Hit](hit_damage) entirely. It only applies to [Physical](physical_damage) Hits from Skills without the [Magic](magic) tag — everything else needs [Spell Dodge](spell_dodge).

The attacker's [Accuracy](accuracy) is subtracted first, and what remains has diminishing returns. The chance to Dodge is capped at §a80%§f.

Dodging is §onot§f a coin flip. Every Hit you take fills a hidden meter by your Dodge chance, and when the meter fills that Hit is avoided and the meter empties. At §a25%§f Dodge you avoid every 4th Hit rather than sometimes eating ten in a row. The meter starts at a random point and resets if you go §a6 seconds§f without being Hit, so you cannot count Hits to predict your next Dodge.

Each Hit gets one Dodge check, however many [Damage Types](damage_types) it is split across.
enlighten.term.spell_dodge:
Spell Dodge is the [Dodge Rating](dodge_rating) counterpart for Skills carrying the [Magic](magic) tag.

It works the same way — the attacker's [Accuracy](accuracy) is subtracted first — but needs a higher rating for the same result, and is capped at §a90%§f.

It fills its own evenly-spread meter, separate from the one [Dodge Rating](dodge_rating) uses, so the two never spend each other's progress.

Only the Hit itself can be dodged — [damage over time](damage_over_time) it leaves behind cannot.
enlighten.term.block:
Block Chance is a passive roll that stops an incoming [Hit](hit_damage) completely — §a100%§f of it, including any part converted to another [Damage Type](damage_types) — unless your Block Damage Reduction is lowered below 100%.

The roll is capped at §a75%§f, raised up to §a90%§f by Maximum Passive Block Chance. A successful block starts a §a1 second§f recovery period, shortened by Increased Block Recovery down to a floor of §a0.25s§f. It §crequires a shield in your off-hand§f.

A Blocked Hit cannot inflict [Ailments](ailment).

Holding block drains [Energy](energy) and stops Energy regeneration.
enlighten.term.penetration:
Penetration is subtracted from the target's [Resistance](resistances) §obefore§f the resistance cap is applied, so a target with heavily over-capped Resistance soaks it harmlessly.

Elemental and Chaos Penetration are percentages. [Physical](physical_damage) damage ignores them entirely — that is what [Armor Penetration](armor_penetration) is for.
enlighten.term.armor_penetration:
Armor Penetration is a §oflat§f value subtracted from the target's [Armour](armour), and only applies to [Physical](physical_damage) Hits.

If it exceeds the target's Armour the leftover is not wasted — it becomes bonus damage instead.
enlighten.term.damage_received:
Damage Received is a stat on the §otarget§f, but it feeds the §osame§f additive pool as the attacker's Increased Damage, so the two simply add together and are applied once.

It is capped at +90%. See [More](more_multiplier) and [Damage Reduction](damage_reduction).
enlighten.term.damage_reduction:
Damage Reduction is its own multiplier, applied late in the damage calculation, and is hard-capped at §a75%§f.

It is not the same as [Damage Received](damage_received), which adds into the attacker's damage pool instead.

Damage Suppression is a separate roll that removes a flat 50% when it succeeds.
enlighten.term.more_multiplier:
Flat, Increased and More are three different things.

§aFlat§f adds to the base value first.

§aIncreased§f from every source sums into a single pool that is applied once — two sources of 100% Increased give +200%, not double.

§aMore§f is applied separately and compounds with itself, which makes it far stronger than the same number written as Increased.
enlighten.term.attack_damage:
Attack Damage applies to Skills that are not Intelligence-based — melee (Strength) and ranged (Dexterity) Skills, and [Basic Attacks](basic_attack).

It is separate from [Skill Damage](skill_damage), which applies to every Skill.
enlighten.term.skill_damage:
Skill Damage applies to §oany§f Skill you cast, melee or magic.

Element-specific Spell Damage is narrower — it also requires the Skill to carry the [Magic](magic) tag.
enlighten.term.basic_attack:
A Basic Attack is your ordinary left-click swing or bow shot.

Its damage comes from your §aWeapon Damage§f stat, not from the vanilla item's damage.

A swing released below 30% charge is cancelled and deals nothing; a swing at 80% charge or more also gains your Full Swing Damage.
enlighten.term.damage_over_time:
Damage over Time is calculated §oonce, at the moment it is applied§f — every stat is snapshotted then.

It ticks once per second for its duration and recalculates nothing, so it can never be a [Critical Hit](critical_hit), and stats you gain afterwards do not change it.

The [Damaging Ailments](damaging_ailment) are the main source.
enlighten.term.leech:
Leech does not restore anything instantly. Each Leech source banks its amount into a pool, and that pool is paid back to you over time.

§cEvery "on Hit" and "on Kill" resource gain in this pack is Leech§f and obeys the [Leech Cap](leech_cap).
enlighten.term.leech_cap:
The Leech Cap limits how fast banked [Leech](leech) is paid back: by default §a5%§f of that resource's maximum per second.

At most 5 seconds' worth can be banked at once, so heavily overkill Leech is lost. Amounts below 1 are never paid out.
enlighten.term.cooldown:
A Cooldown is the wait before a Skill can be used again.

Cooldown Reduction shortens Cooldowns and [Charge Regen](charge_regen) §oonly§f. It does nothing to [Cast Time](cast_time) or Recovery, and only matters on Skills whose Cooldown is longer than their Recovery.
enlighten.term.cast_time:
Cast Time is how long a Skill takes to go off; Recovery is the pause afterwards.

Skill Speed shortens both: §aMagic Skill Speed§f for magic Skills, §aAttack Skill Speed§f for melee and ranged Skills, and §aChannel Speed§f for [Channelled](channel) Skills. +100% means twice as many casts or pulses.

Skill Speed never shortens a [Cooldown](cooldown), and it is not the same stat as [Attack Speed](attack_speed).
enlighten.term.attack_speed:
Attack Speed increases the speed of your [Basic Attacks](basic_attack), and the [Skill Speed](cast_time) of Skills carrying the Attack tag.

§cIt does not apply to Summons or Mercenaries§f, because they do not use Attacks.

It is a different stat from §aAttack Skill Speed§f, which only affects Skills.
enlighten.term.charge_regen:
Some Skills store several uses, called Charges, which refill on a timer. Charge Regen is that timer.

§cThis is unrelated to [Endurance](endurance_charge), [Frenzy](frenzy_charge) and [Power](power_charge) Charges.§f

It is shortened by Cooldown Reduction.
enlighten.term.endurance_charge:
A defensive charge. You can hold up to 3, they last 30 seconds, and all stacks share one timer — gaining a new one refreshes them all.

Each stack grants §a+3 Physical Damage Reduction from Hits§f.
enlighten.term.frenzy_charge:
An offensive charge. Up to 3, lasting 30 seconds, all stacks sharing one timer.

Each stack grants §a3% More Total Damage§f, §a+6 Magic Skill Speed§f and §a+6 Attack Speed§f.
enlighten.term.power_charge:
A critical-strike charge. Up to 3, lasting 30 seconds, all stacks sharing one timer.

Each stack grants §a25% Increased [Critical Hit](critical_hit)§f chance.
enlighten.term.regeneration:
Regeneration ticks §oonce per second§f, despite some stat descriptions saying "every few seconds".

Health Regeneration requires a food level of at least 1. Percentage-based regeneration is capped at 25% of the pool per second.
enlighten.term.very_low_health:
You are on Very Low Health at §a25%§f or less of your maximum Health or [Magic Shield](magic_shield).

This is a stricter threshold than [Low Health](low_health), which is 30%. Only the higher of the two pools is checked.
enlighten.term.mana:
Mana is the resource magic Skills spend. It regenerates once per second.

Stats that absorb damage with Mana only work while you are above 50% Mana, and will never drain you below that line.
enlighten.term.energy:
Energy is the resource weapon Skills spend. It regenerates like [Mana](mana), once per second.

§cHolding block drains Energy and stops Energy regeneration entirely.§f Running out while blocking puts both hands on a 3 second cooldown.
enlighten.term.blood:
Blood replaces [Mana](mana) for characters who take the §4Blood Mage§f game-changer talent. Your Mana and Energy are gone, and your Blood pool is worth half your Health.

§cBlood has no natural regeneration.§f Instead, healing that does not come from a Skill refills it.
enlighten.term.stun:
A Stunned target has its Movement Speed, Attack Speed and Attack Damage reduced to zero for the duration.

There are §cno diminishing returns and no stun immunity stat§f. Higher rarity mobs instead have increased resistance to every [Debuff](debuff), so they are stunned weakly rather than not at all.
enlighten.term.slow:
Slow, shown as Lethargy, reduces Movement Speed by 25% and Attack Speed by 10%.

It is separate from the slow that [Freeze](freeze) applies, and separate from [Stun](stun).
enlighten.term.threat:
Every monster tracks how much Threat each attacker has generated, and attacks whoever holds the most.

Damage you deal and damage you take both generate Threat. Taunts add Threat directly; some Skills remove it instead.
enlighten.term.debuff:
A Debuff is a negative effect placed on a target.

Higher rarity mobs have §cinnate resistance to the effect of negative buffs§f, which weakens every Debuff you land on them, and they periodically strip Debuffs off entirely.
enlighten.term.scorched: Scorched is a [Debuff](debuff) that lowers the target's Elemental [Resistances](resistances) by 10.
enlighten.term.fortify: Fortify grants §a+8 [Damage Reduction](damage_reduction)§f while you hold it.
enlighten.term.area_of_effect:
Area of Effect scales how large the affected area of an [Area](area) Skill is.

A few Skills have a fixed overall boundary — for those, Area of Effect widens each individual impact inside the boundary rather than the boundary itself.
enlighten.term.combo:
The Brawler combo chain has four steps, and each step consumes the stack the previous one gave you.

§aCombo Starter§f — granted by [Basic Attacks](basic_attack) while [Fury](fury) is active, lasts 6 seconds.
§aCombo Linker§f — granted by [Linker](linker) Skills, lasts 120 seconds.
§aCombo Extender§f — granted by [Extender](extender) Skills, lasts 120 seconds.

[Finisher](finisher) Skills consume the Combo Extender and grant nothing — they are the payoff.
enlighten.term.fury: Fury is the Brawler's offensive stance. It grants gauntlet damage and Attack Speed, and the chance for [Basic Attacks](basic_attack) to generate a Combo Starter — which is what makes the whole [Combo](combo) chain work.
enlighten.term.stance:
§cFighter Stance§f raises Attack Speed and Move Speed at the cost of defences. §aDefender Stance§f raises defences and taunts nearby enemies at the cost of speed.

Stances also change what Fighter Skills do, and §6Fighter Skills are less effective while no Stance is active§f.
enlighten.term.overheat:
Overheat stacks up to 4 times. Each stack grants §a10% More Intelligence and Cold Skill Damage§f but §c20% less resource regeneration and [Leech](leech)§f.

Fire Skills generate stacks; Cold Skills consume one and refund [Mana](mana).

At 4 stacks you are §cFully Overheated§f, which upgrades what many Skills do.
enlighten.term.mage_armor:
Mage Armor is a toggle — cast it again to remove it.

While active it grants [Magic Shield](magic_shield), cross-converts your Fire and Cold [Penetration](penetration), and gives you the chance to trigger [Elemental Burst](elemental_burst).
enlighten.term.elemental_burst:
Elemental Burst is a free burst of Cold and Fire damage at the target.

It is triggered by Skills carrying the [Burst](burst) tag while [Mage Armor](mage_armor) is active, and has its own short internal cooldown. Skills that can trigger it say so on their tooltip.
enlighten.term.augment:
Augments are gems that grant a permanent bonus while equipped, similar to an [Aura](aura).

Each one permanently [reserves](reservation) part of your Augment Capacity, so how many you can run at once depends on that capacity. You cannot equip two of the same Augment.
enlighten.term.reservation:
Reservation is the amount of Augment Capacity that an equipped [Augment](augment) permanently locks up.

Stats that reduce reservation cost let you fit more Augments at once.
enlighten.term.chrono_stacks:
Alpha, Beta and Gamma are Chronomancer markers, up to 3 of each.

§cThey grant no stats on their own§f — that is intentional. They are consumed when you use a Chronomancer Skill, and §owhich combination you are holding§f changes what that Skill does.
enlighten.term.snow_tracked:
Snow-Tracked is a Cryolancer marker placed on enemies, up to 3 stacks.

§cIt grants no stats on its own§f — Cryolancer Skills check for it and consume it to trigger their bonus effects.
enlighten.term.soul_stacks:
Soul is a Warlock marker placed on enemies, up to 5 stacks.

§cIt grants no stats on its own§f — it is a counter that other Warlock Skills read and spend.

It is not the same as the Warlock's §aSpirit§f self-buff.
enlighten.term.channel:
Channelled Skills keep pulsing while you hold the key down.

Their pulse rate is scaled by Channel Speed, which is a form of [Skill Speed](cast_time). A Channelled Skill pays its resource cost on every pulse.
enlighten.term.totem: Totems are stationary constructs you place down, which cast on your behalf until they expire or are destroyed.
enlighten.term.banner:
Banners are placed effects that strengthen you and your [Allies](allies) in an area for a duration.

§cYou can only have one Banner active at a time.§f
enlighten.term.cursed: Skills with the Cursed tag apply, or benefit from, [Curses](curse).
enlighten.term.shrine: Shrines are temporary buffs picked up inside Maps. Each grants one strong bonus — speed, damage, defence, charges, resistances and so on — for a short time.
enlighten.term.always:
This number cannot be changed. The enemy's [Resistance](resistances) for this element is skipped completely, so their own resistance, your [Penetration](penetration), and any effect that raises or lowers their resistance make no difference.

Damage of that element is always calculated as if the enemy had exactly 0% resistance.
